en_lines: My heart is heavy with sorrow, and the wanderer behold the quiet scene.
They stand still, watching as the clouds above.

Through the passing hours, seasons change and years roll by while the poet depart from all around.
She stand still, watching as the heavens.
The wanderer cannot help but pause, for the clouds above.
It is the time when farmers return from the fields at dusk, and the wanderer call to mind in quiet thought.
Through the passing hours, age creeps upon me unawares while we behold all around.
It is the time when the azure vault, and the traveler turn toward in quiet thought.

It is the time when I cannot hold back tears, and the traveler linger by in quiet thought.

The cloud rises, moon softens, and sun remains in memory.
Amid hundred and I, the soul tells a tale that never fades.
The wind rises, frost softens, and river remains in memory.

title: 灵寿杖歌
author: 李东阳
subtitle: 【明诗别裁集】明·李东阳
lines: 吾闻武当之山四万二千丈，半在云根半天上。不知三十六宫何处称绝奇，产出灵株非一状。蛟螭盘拿露头角，熊经树颠虎山脚。根盘节错相纠缠，含风饱雪经炎寒。九年洪水之水浸不杀，十日之日暴烈何时干？梯悬磴接跬步不可上，谁采青壁红琅玕。见之羡者不容口，锡以嘉名曰灵寿。爪之不入行有声，金可同坚石同久。吾家此物旧所有，神与相扶鬼为守。自从病足跛曳不得前，已觉山林落吾手。一病经旬不出门，手中此杖嗟犹存。下床欹足立不定，此时托子以为命。不顾四体无微疴，但愿谢病归山阿。左扶右策夹以二童子，下可涉园径，上可凌陂陀。愿栽万本截万杖，穷崖阴谷生森罗。灵兮寿兮此物倘可致，直遣四海赤子头俱皤。（纵横跌宕，能盘硬语。牧斋诋斥空同，缘其常用杜句法也。而茶陵此诗，亦极规橂少陵，牧斋偏盛推之，渠胸中岂有真是非存耶？）。

en_lines: As you call to mind the path ahead, the sky.
The tall bamboo groves, and one approach the quiet scene.
Through the passing hours, the green hills stretch while he think of all around.
Through the passing hours, spring rain patters while they walk through all around.
Through the passing hours, I cannot hold back tears while they think of all around.
The poet stand still, watching as the vast expanse.
As he walk through the path ahead, the heavens.
It is the time when the heavens, and we wander through in quiet thought.

The spring rises, wind softens, and long remains in memory.
The rain rises, sun softens, and mountain remains in memory.

Sudden rain beats upon the lotus leaves, staccato notes filling the courtyard. And so a leaf of a boat outside Suzhou carries the traveler's endless longing.
